'''Inishlinn''' is a city in [[Murandy]].{{ref/book|2|4}} In keeping with what seems to be Murandian tradition, people from the city refer to themselves as Inishlinni rather than Murandians.{{ref/book|2|4}}{{ref|{{twotc}}, Inishlinni}}

==Parallels==
The name is distinctly Irish in flavour. In Irish, "[http://www.fallingrain.com/world/EI/a/I/ Inish/Inis/Innis]" means "[[wikipedia:Inniskeen|island]]" and "Linn" meaning "pool" (e.g. Dubh Linn/[[wikipedia:Dublin|Dublin]] means Black Pool). Both are commonly used in place names.
